independent_local_defect.after: Original locator is intersected with :visible; the same live locator performs count, wait, trial and dispatch. No first/nth fallback.

contracts.episode_reset: Only a successful browser.interact click/fill/select/press/assert resets the counter.
contracts.match_count: visible matches; zero with hidden DOM matches is selector_not_visible, zero without DOM matches is selector_no_match
contracts.locator: Locator.and with :visible, reused live for readiness and dispatch; no selector rewriting or first/nth selection
contracts.dispatched_action_failure: terminal action_or_after; retryable false; uncertain action_performed never false
